key_insight: RubricsTree is a scalable, expert-aligned evaluation system that uses over 100 clinical rubrics to judge personal health agents more consistently than generic LLM judges.
clinical_relevance: It could help developers and clinicians more reliably assess whether health AI gives contextually correct, medically grounded responses before real-world use.
method: Built a hierarchical taxonomy of 100+ atomic Boolean rubrics
Curated from 4,000 real user queries with physician-led human-in-the-loop review
Uses a context-aware router to activate only the relevant rubric subset per query
evidence_signal: In meta-evaluation, RubricsTree outperformed a strong baseline on expert alignment, penalized degraded answers more reliably, and improved HealthBench performance by up to about 66% relative across Gemini, GPT, and Qwen families.
watch_item: The rubric system still depends on expert curation and may need ongoing updates to stay aligned with evolving clinical practice and new query types.
paper_title: RubricsTree: Scalable and Evolving Open-Ended Evaluation of Personal Health Agents across Health Memory and Medical Skills
